name: remora-hub
description: Remora hub: a small self-hosted Cloudflare Worker that relays between your DSH hosts and ChatGPT, Claude, the CLI and the HTTP API.

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test/unit && tsc --noEmit -p test/integration
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration

SETUP_TOKEN.description: One-time secret for registering the first passkey (16+ characters). Generate a long random value, keep a copy, and enter it on the hub's setup page. 最初のパスキー登録に一度だけ使う合言葉（16 文字以上）。控えておき、ハブの初期設定画面で入力します。
